title: Exchange complete historical evidence through bounded resumable Git packs
outcome: An explicit full-evidence profile moves complete selected task-scoped historical graphs and optional selected artifacts between enrolled stores, retaining original facts and exact replay while making no destination credit or runtime mutation.
acceptance: An explicit full-evidence export/import round-trips every selected historical family in accepted design §§2–3 and its typed dependency closure, including quiet observations, governing snapshots and actual revision objects, in immutable bounded packs. A→B→A tests preserve original UUIDs, canonical bytes, links, origins, pack identity and legacy meanings; same-id different-kind/bytes refuses atomically; live claims, sessions, path selection and uncredited checks gain no authority.

Origin-qualified feed segment/cut and governing-snapshot witnesses retain actual work-event/context dependencies and complete required intervals outside destination native feeds. Behavioral cases refuse missing interior source/root/claim events, gaps, beyond-cut entries, changed membership and broken known continuity; exact overlap replays and unavailable exact governing snapshots remain explicit.

The existing family-neutral binding/chain and single pending slot gain typed evidence/artifact operations and explicit planning Deferred outcomes without redefining historical task-only receipts. Tests cover planning held by a live claim, evidence retained independently, fresh planning successor after normal claim end, immutable old Deferred replay, zero-payload completed replay, and an unfinished preparation that still blocks; settlement never advances applied planning coverage.

Full selected history bootstraps and advances in bounded dependency-complete batches using keyed changed-object/feed views, with no silent scan or history reload on normal deltas/replay. Cases exercise the accepted record/pack/component/batch/plan/attachment/staging limits, oversized SCC refusal, partial progress/resume and crash rollback; no required record is truncated or marked applied across a gap.

Evidence-only Git changes advance only their family; task deletion/profile omission retains evidence. Explicit optional attachments preserve origin locators and do not read foreign absolute paths or private scratch; absent logs remain unavailable. Updated profile/disclosure/docs and bounded agent output state that imported records are retained facts, not destination satisfaction, and implementation names its actual projection/durable cutover under repository rules.
